title: Dude, Where’s My Recession?

title: The Token Economy Requires Collective Data Governance

title: Excess Savings Are Driving the New China Shock
summary: The current China shock combines continued supply upgrading with an absorption problem: the decline in property and related investment has reduced domestic demand, but national saving remains very high. The result is a larger savings-investment surplus that spills into net exports.
